k-city.title: Bawsaq GTA 6 Vice City stock exchange coins
k-city.sourceSays: Posts say $BAWSAQ brings GTA's fictional Vice City stock market to Solana memecoins, with a themed site; a project-style post describes launching GTA6-themed coins on pump.fun.
k-city.reason: Posts of Nov 13 describe the GTA 6 Vice City stock exchange concept behind BAWSAQ; most other results are call-group shills, ignored. Claim unverified.

k-jacket.reason: A Jensen Huang leather jacket meme may exist, but the search was refunded as off-target, the JACKET pool on four.meme is months old, and most JENSLA posts are call-group shills.
